ei.title: How the Internet Reshaped Fashion Retail
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.

questions.passage: The internet has (A)[transformed / preserved] the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to (B)[predict / guarantee] the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more (C)[informed / confused] than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① preserved: 패션 시장을 '보존했다'는 인터넷이 패션 시장을 근본적으로 바꿨다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② transformed - predict - informed = 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ guarantee: 수요를 '보장하다'는 예측이 어려워졌다는 맥락과 불일치
❌ ④ confused: 소비자가 '혼란스러운'은 '정보에 밝은(informed)'이라는 원문과 반대

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain (A)[comparative / identical] information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is (B)[exacerbated / alleviated] by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more (C)[exclusive / common] pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① comparative - exacerbated - exclusive = 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② identical: '동일한' 정보는 비교 가능한(comparative) 정보와 다른 의미
❌ ③ alleviated: 상황을 '완화시키다'는 '악화시키다(exacerbated)'의 반대
❌ ④ common: '흔한' 제품은 차별화하려는 소비자의 맥락과 반대

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, (A)[transferring / consolidating] the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, (B)[facilitated / hindered] through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their individual style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to (C)[differentiate / conform] themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① consolidating: 권력을 '통합하다'는 소매업체에서 고객으로 '이전하다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② hindered: 라이브스트리밍을 통해 '방해된'은 '촉진된(facilitated)'과 반대
❌ ③ conform: '순응하다'는 '차별화하다(differentiate)'와 반대
✅ ④ transferring - facilitated - differentiate = 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: The internet has ①<u>transformed</u> the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost ②<u>gradually</u>, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to express their ③<u>individual</u> style and personality, especially those promoting 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as enough, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a problem for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding ④<u>affordable</u> prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① transformed: 인터넷이 패션 시장을 '변화시켰다' → 적절
✅ ② gradually: 비교 정보를 '점진적으로' 얻는다는 것은 '거의 즉시(instantaneously)' 얻는다는 원문과 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ individual: '개인적인' 스타일과 개성 → 적절
❌ ④ affordable: '저렴한' 가격을 여전히 요구한다 → 적절

questions.passage: The internet has transformed the fashion marketplace, making it increasingly difficult to predict the demand for the selling season. Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the balance of power from the retailer to the customer. This is exacerbated by open and real-time access to fashion shows, facilitated through livestreaming, coupled with social media access to celebrity looks and lifestyles and the sharing of all aspects of life on social media. Consumers use fashion choices to ①<u>express</u> their individual style and personality, especially those ②<u>promoting</u> 'brand me' on social media. The traditional two-season offer is no longer seen as ③<u>enough</u>, with consumers demanding new products throughout the whole year. This creates a ④<u>solution</u> for fashion retailers as many consumers are looking for more exclusive pieces to differentiate themselves, forcing up the desire for trend-led ever more rapidly changing styles, while still demanding affordable prices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① express: 패션 선택으로 스타일을 '표현하다' → 적절
❌ ② promoting: 소셜 미디어에서 '브랜드 나'를 '홍보하는' → 적절
❌ ③ enough: 전통적 시즌 제안이 더 이상 '충분한' 것으로 여겨지지 않는다 → 적절
✅ ④ solution: 패션 소매업자에게 '해결책'을 만든다는 것은 '문제(problem)'를 만든다는 원문과 모순 ←정답

det.analysis:
❌ ① increasingly: 수요 예측이 '점점 더' 어려워진다 → 적절
❌ ② balance: 권력의 '균형'이 이동한다 → 적절
✅ ③ innovative: '혁신적인' 두 시즌 제안은 '전통적인(traditional)'이라는 원문과 모순. 이미 충분하지 않다고 여겨지는 것은 전통적인 방식 ←정답

❌ ③ reasonable: '합리적인'은 affordable과 유사한 의미

questions.passage:
(A) The government tried to <u>balance</u> the national budget by cutting unnecessary expenses and increasing tax revenues.

(B) Consumers can browse for product information and prices and gain comparative information almost instantaneously, making them more informed than ever before, transferring the <u>balance</u> of power from the retailer to the customer.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 balance의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 균형을 맞추다(동사) = 예산의 수지를 맞추다, (B) 균형(명사) = 권력의 균형/세력 관계
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 균형을 맞추다/(B) 균형: (A)는 예산 균형을 맞추는 동사, (B)는 권력의 균형이라는 명사 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 잔액/(B) 균형을 맞추다: 문법적으로 (A)는 동사이므로 잔액(명사)은 부적절
❌ ③ (A) 균형을 맞추다/(B) 잔액: (B)는 'balance of power'로 권력의 균형이지 잔액이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 저울질하다/(B) 잔고: 맥락과 불일치
det.tip: balance: (A) 균형을 맞추다(동사) vs (B) 균형(명사, balance of power)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to make a situation worse or more severe"

det.korean: 상황을 더 나쁘게 또는 더 심각하게 만들다 = exacerbate(악화시키다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① facilitate: '촉진하다'는 상황을 나쁘게 만드는 것이 아님
❌ ② differentiate: '구별하다/차별화하다'는 악화와 무관
❌ ③ transform: '변형하다'는 좋고 나쁨과 무관한 변화
